stage149_energy_gauge.message: Stage149 already used fitted per-element atomic energies; residual per-element calibration on valid 0:128 did not transfer to valid 128:1024.

root_cause_assessment: The observed energy MAE/RMSE problem is real: current best rTECE raw E RMSE is roughly 52.5 meV/atom, over 2x worse than the NEP smoke E RMSE on the same community-baseline stage.
It is not explained by the old global energy_per_atom_shift alone because current training fits per-element atomic_energies, and Stage150 residual per-element calibration did not transfer.
It is not primarily a local NEB-shape failure: relative image RMSE and barrier RMSE are around 7-11 meV/atom, while group-offset oracle RMSE is around 4.8 meV/atom.
It is not fixed by current implemented rTECE semantic descriptors used as simple low-frequency baseline proxies: Stage169 LOOCV selects intercept-only, while all current descriptors overfit offsets.
The most likely root cause is missing deployable low-frequency chemical/site/adsorbate representation plus insufficient teacher-coverage/downfolding, not just head size or optimizer tuning.
next_priority: Keep E/F RMSE, E/F MAE, and E/F max errors as primary metrics; raw E RMSE must remain visible, but relative image/barrier and physical tests are required to avoid overfitting absolute offsets.
Do not add a case-id or group-offset feature; it would solve the benchmark oracle but is not deployable.
Do not spend the next round on another post-hoc E0/gauge toggle unless a new diagnostic shows composition-only residual transfer.

Design Stage171 around teacher-selected residual scalar paths or semantic active-set projections for the case-offset residual, then train the same student architecture from scratch versus renormalized/distilled initialization.
In parallel, keep NEP/DPA comparisons as reference endpoints, but the algorithmic route should remain TECE-style controlled path retention plus teacher cache/projection/downfolding.
